title: Dual pulled-back module base change
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-picard-pullback-base-change, the canonical base-change map for the dual pulled-back module is invertible for every h.

proof.text: The duals of E and N are finite locally free by Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.dual. For any scheme morphism k, the chosen tensor-pullback adjunction and the ordinary pullback adjunction share pushforward as right adjoint. Their leftAdjointUniq isomorphism c identifies the two pullback functors.

Apply nonempty_pullback_dual_iso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree to M. Compose c at M^dual, that duality comparison, and dualFunctor.mapIso of (c at M).op to obtain tensorPullback k (M^dual) isomorphic to the dual of tensorPullback k M. This is the proved private helper tensorPullback_dual_iso.

At q = pullback.fst f g and p = pullback.snd f g, let dE and dN be the comparisons just obtained. If i represents e, the composition dE followed by the inverse of dualFunctor.mapIso i.op followed by dN inverse identifies q^*(E^dual) with p^*(N^dual). Apply the primal base-change theorem to E^dual and N^dual, this isomorphism, the original hO and h.

proof_origin.note: Formalized by applying the existing primal theorem to the dual modules; pullback-duality comparison from Tag 0FNV is transported along uniqueness of left adjoints.

theorem picard_pullback_base_change_dual {X S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hO : ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : T' ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g'))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T'.ringCatSheaf)))
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S) (N : T.Modules) [N.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (e : Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E ≅
      (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj N))
    {T' : Scheme.{u}} (h : T' ⟶ T) :
      IsIso (Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) h (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
        pullback.condition
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj (Modules.dual E)))
